content: Challenger commercial-teaching pitch has a documented 6-step choreography: Warmer (build credibility, show you understand their world), Reframe (connect to a bigger problem/opportunity they hadn't considered), Rational Drowning (numbers proving the cost of the status quo), Emotional Impact (make the cost personal/felt), A New Way (vendor-neutral reframe of how to solve it), then the solution presented last. Solution comes last deliberately so the buyer accepts the problem before hearing the pitch. Cross-checked against challengerinc.com (official blog) and independent summaries (Anaplan PDF summary, pitchmonster, Forbes).
